title: bot.ability.vocal.speech.encoding.input
description: A request to encode a reply as verbal speech: the reply's whole parts (decision D178).

parts.description: The reply's parts, encoded in order: their words, joined exactly as written, are said, and a part's expression.pause is said as silence [floppy field].

items.description: One stretch of your reply and, optionally, how to say it. Split the reply into parts where the way you say it changes, or to put a sound or a pause between words. The words are only what is spoken; a laugh, sigh or other non-verbal sound is expression.sound and a silence is expression.pause, never written into the words, and either may be a part of its own with no words. Every part has words, a sound or a pause.

expression.description: How to say this part, written before its words; omit it to say the words naturally.

instructions.description: Natural-language acting direction for this part.

emotion.description: A feeling, as free text. A voice with a closed vocabulary of emotions applies it only on an exact match.

style.description: A named style the voice declares; 'whisper' is the canonical name for whispering.

intensity.description: How strongly to carry the emotion or style, from 0 to 1.

pace.description: Speaking rate relative to natural: 1 is natural, 2 twice as fast.

pitch.description: Pitch in semitones relative to natural: 0 is natural.

volume.description: Loudness relative to natural, linear: 1 is natural.

emphasis.description: Stress the words of this part.

pause.description: A silence, short or long, that opens this part, before its sound and words; a part may be only a pause, with no words. This is the only way to pause: a written pause would be read aloud. Every voice can pause.

sound.description: A non-verbal sound (a laugh, sigh, gasp and the like), one per part: made beside this part's words, placed by sound_at, or alone as a part of its own with no words. This is the only way to make one: a written 'sigh' would be read aloud as speech. A voice that cannot make the sound ignores it.

sound_at.description: Whether the sound comes before or after this part's words; meaningful only with a sound.

words.description: The words of this part; omit them for a part that is only a sound or a pause. The voice speaks every character exactly as written, so this is speech only: no stage directions, actions, emotes, markup or tags, and none of the characters * < > [ ] { } ( ): a cue such as (chuckle) or (pause) would be read aloud. For a sound (a laugh, chuckle or sigh) use expression.sound; for a pause use expression.pause; for how to say the words use expression. Continue the reply exactly, including any space or punctuation that joins this part to the one before it.
